docs.title: Workshop Catalog
docs.text: Hands-on UiPath workshops built by the Partner Success team. Each course is a participant handbook on its own site; each exercise is a complete business case with the environment prepared for you.

docs.title: Agentic Automation Workshop (Agentic Practice)
docs.text:
Hands-on introduction to UiPath agentic automation for people practising for the first time — three exercises, each a complete business case.

Audience: workshop participants new to agents; no developer background required

Exercise What you build Level Products Before you start Categorizing ServiceNow Incidents Build a low-code agent that triages IT incidents with tools, context grounding, an escalation app and agent memory. 100 Agents (low-code), Context Grounding, Action Center, Integration Service Conversational Agents Build a multi-turn conversational agent that reuses the incident tools. 100 Conversational Agents, Agents (low-code) Categorizing ServiceNow Incidents Two-Way Matching of Invoices and Purchase Orders Orchestrate a Maestro BPMN process with IXP extraction, a low-code matching agent and a human validation app. 200 Maestro BPMN, IXP, Agents (low-code), Action Center, Orchestrator Categorizing ServiceNow Incidents

docs.title: UiPath Coding Agents Workshop
docs.text:
Build UiPath agents and Maestro orchestrations with a coding agent and the uip CLI — from installing the tools to shipping an end-to-end solution.

Audience: technical clients and partners who know the UiPath platform and are new to AI coding agents

Exercise What you build Level Products Before you start Build Your First Agent Build a low-code Claims Eligibility agent from two PDFs with a coding agent, give it an evaluation set, and run a test-and-fix loop from the CLI. 100 Agents (low-code), Agent Evals, uip CLI & skills Getting Started with Coding Agents Getting Started with Coding Agents Install the uip CLI and the UiPath skills, authenticate, and practise the platform read commands before the first build. 100 uip CLI & skills Loan Application Underwriting An AI underwriting agent, a loan-officer review app, a Maestro Flow orchestration and an RPA intake step, built with a coding agent. 200 Agents (coded), Coded Apps, Maestro Flow, RPA, uip CLI & skills Getting Started with Coding Agents A Simple Maestro BPMN Process with a Coding Agent Model and deploy a small BPMN process in Maestro by driving a coding agent — a standalone exercise between the first agent and the end-to-end builds. 100 Maestro BPMN, uip CLI & skills Build Your First Agent

docs.title: ClaimCase — Property Claims with Coding Agents
docs.text:
Build an enterprise property-claims solution end to end by driving your own coding agent — design, plan, build, verify, ship.

Audience: experienced UiPath developers (level 300)

Exercise What you build Level Products Before you start ClaimCase end-to-end build One day, one solution — IXP extraction, Data Fabric entity, agents, a Maestro case, a Coded Action App and a process app, generated from a seed with a coding agent. 300 uip CLI & skills, Maestro Case, Agents (low-code), IXP, Data Fabric, Coded Apps, Action Center, Orchestrator Getting Started with Coding Agents

docs.title: IXP Self-Paced Training
docs.text:
Self-paced modules on Intelligent Extraction Processing — taxonomy, classification, extraction, validation.

Audience: anyone learning document processing on UiPath

docs.title: Cartographer Tech Workshop
docs.text:
Design a real business process with UiPath Cartographer, from discovery evidence to a reviewed PDD, and follow it to production.

Audience: technical clients and partners new to Cartographer; half day

Exercise What you build Level Products Before you start Warranty Resolution at Cobalt Ridge Automation From a blank Cartographer project to a published PDD with provenance on every fact. 200 Cartographer From Process to Production Cartographer turns the PDD into an SDD; a coding agent builds and tests the solution; it runs in Maestro and Orchestrator. 200 Cartographer, uip CLI & skills, Maestro BPMN Warranty Resolution at Cobalt Ridge Automation

docs.title: Agentic Automation Workshop — Benefit Claims
docs.text:
Implement a government Benefit Claims process — BPMN in Maestro, IXP extraction, three agents, human validation, Integration Service notification.

Audience: professional-track workshop participants

Exercise What you build Level Products Before you start Benefit Claims Processing Nine steps from BPMN model to a running process coordinating robots, agents and a human. 200 Maestro BPMN, IXP, RPA, Agents (low-code), Action Center, Integration Service

docs.title: Agentic Automation with Coding Agents — Benefit Claims
docs.text:
The Benefit Claims process built with coding agents.

Audience: professional-track workshop participants

docs.title: Coding Agents Workshop — Recruitment Pipeline
docs.text:
Build a recruitment pipeline with a coded agent, an RPA workflow and a Maestro Flow, driven by a coding agent.

Audience: partner developers new to coding agents

Exercise What you build Level Products Before you start Recruitment Pipeline hands-on A coded agent, an RPA workflow and a Maestro Flow in two 90-minute blocks. 200 uip CLI & skills, Agents (coded), RPA, Maestro Flow
